title: The European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages in Hungary

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary signed the *Regionális vagy Kisebbségi Nyelvek Európai Kartája* and ratified it in 1995, undertaking specific commitments for a number of minority languages (including German, Slovak, Romanian, Serbian, Croatian, Romani and Boyash).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The Charter and the Hungarian nationality law call for measures such as bilingual place-name signs (*kétnyelvű helységnévtáblák*), mother-tongue kindergarten instruction and the use of the minority language in local government, under conditions set by law.
